_note: Source of truth for the reviews wall. Edit here, then run: python tools/build-reviews.py
_source: Shopify App Store CSV export for clickpost-order-edit-cancel; country looked up from the listing by review id

_fields.quote: required - review text, no surrounding quote marks (the card draws those)
_fields.name: required - store name
_fields.date: optional - review date, shown on the right of the card
_fields.country: optional - store country, shown under the date
_fields.rating: optional - stars, kept so the wall can be filtered
_fields.logo: optional - path under assets/ for the brand mark
_fields.logoAlt: optional - accessible name for the logo
